postings.title: Data Engineer
postings.description:
Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@tebra.com, @patientpop.com, or @kareo.com) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.
About the Role

As a Data Engineer focused on AI/ML, you’ll build, maintain, and optimize the data infrastructure that powers Tebra’s intelligent features. You’ll partner closely with Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, and Software Engineers to transform complex healthcare data into high-quality datasets and real-time features that enable machine learning models.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll contribute to scalable data pipelines, improve data quality, and help ensure our AI systems are powered by reliable, performant, and well-governed data. You’ll work on modern data platforms and gain experience building solutions that support both model training and production inference.

Your Area of Focus

- Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines for feature extraction, training data generation, and model monitoring.

- Develop and enhance data systems that support analytics and machine learning workloads, including data lakehouse and feature store technologies.

- Monitor production data pipelines, identify data quality issues or pipeline failures, and implement improvements to ensure reliability and freshness.

- Participate in engineering design discussions and contribute to technical decisions around data architecture and pipeline implementation.

- Build reusable data engineering components, including automated data quality checks, schema validation, and testing frameworks.

- Translate business requirements into scalable data solutions that enable analytics and machine learning use cases.

- Optimize SQL queries, Spark workloads, and data processing pipelines to improve performance and scalability.

- Collaborate with ML Engineers and cross-functional partners to support MLOps best practices, including data versioning, lineage, and reproducibility.

- Break down technical work into manageable tasks and deliver high-quality solutions within an agile team.

Your Professional Qualifications

- 3+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.

- 2+ years of hands-on experience building and maintaining production data pipelines supporting analytics, reporting, or machine learning workloads.

- Strong proficiency in Python and SQL with experience developing production-quality data pipelines.

- Experience with modern data processing technologies such as Spark, Airflow, Kafka, or similar distributed data platforms.

- Experience working with cloud-based data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Delta Lake, or equivalent lakehouse technologies.

- Understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and data governance best practices.

- Familiarity with machine learning data workflows, including training datasets, feature engineering, and data quality concepts.

- Experience deploying and supporting production data pipelines with monitoring, testing, and CI/CD practices.

- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering and product teams.

- Excellent communication skills and a desire to continuously learn new technologies and engineering practices.

postings.title: Manager, GTM Engineering (TAM & Outbound)
postings.description:
Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@tebra.com, @patientpop.com, or @kareo.com) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.
About the Role

We’re looking for a Manager of GTM Engineering to help build the data and activation engine behind Tebra’s next generation of outbound growth. You’ll help create and evolve a comprehensive Total Addressable Market database of independent healthcare practices and related businesses, combining public, proprietary, and third-party data into actionable segments, signals, and outbound workflows. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, Clay, GTM systems, and outbound strategy—and is ideal for someone who can both architect the system and get hands-on building the workflows that turn market intelligence into a pipeline.

Your Area of Focus

- Build and evolve Tebra’s TAM database, creating a reliable and actionable view of independent healthcare practices, providers, billing companies, and other priority market segments.

- Own sophisticated Clay workflows and architecture, including enrichment waterfalls, provider and vendor integrations, scoring logic, custom signals, AI research, segmentation, and activation.

- Integrate data from multiple sources, including public datasets, APIs, enrichment vendors, web scraping, internal systems, and proprietary data, into a scalable GTM data model.

- Manage and develop two GTM Engineers, spanning database infrastructure and Clay/AI automation; translate business priorities into a clear technical roadmap, allocate work across the team, remove blockers, and ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, and tied to measurable GTM outcomes.

- Design and maintain the connection between Clay, Snowflake, Salesforce, Outreach, and other GTM systems, ensuring data can move reliably from source to enrichment to segmentation to activation.

- Build data quality and governance mechanisms, including deduplication, validation, suppression logic, enrichment freshness, field mapping, monitoring, and auditability.

- Develop and operationalize market signals that improve how we identify, prioritize, and engage prospective customers, including firmographic, technographic, behavioral, competitive, and other trigger-based signals.

- Partner with Marketing program owners and Sales leaders to co-develop outbound strategy, translating ICP, campaign, and market hypotheses into executable targeting, enrichment, and activation workflows.

- Design and test outbound motions that use improved data, AI, personalization, and trigger-based targeting to increase relevance and conversion while maintaining appropriate unit economics.

- Own the technical architecture behind outbound experimentation, enabling the organization to quickly test new audiences, signals, channels, personalization strategies, and campaign concepts.

- Monitor the economics of the GTM data stack, including enrichment usage, API costs, Clay credits, vendor overlap, cost per enriched record, and other infrastructure costs.

- Build monitoring and alerting for data pipeline failures, enrichment gaps, sync issues, activation problems, and other conditions that could impact outbound performance.

- Create scalable systems rather than one-off lists, designing architecture, documentation, and governance that allow Tebra’s TAM data and outbound capabilities to compound over time.

Your Professional Qualifications

- 5+ years of relevant experience across GTM engineering, growth engineering, data engineering, revenue operations, outbound systems, technical growth, or a related discipline.

- Deep, hands-on experience with Clay, including building production-scale workflows, enrichment waterfalls, APIs, custom logic, scoring, AI enrichment, and downstream activation.

- Strong proficiency with SQL, APIs, webhooks, and scripting using Python, JavaScript, or similar languages.

- Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake and understanding data modeling, ingestion, transformation, and data quality concepts.

- Experience integrating and operationalizing large or complex datasets from sources such as public registries, enrichment providers, scraping platforms, and third-party APIs.

- Experience with GTM systems such as Salesforce, Outreach, ZoomInfo, Marketo, Slack, and related enrichment or activation tools.

- Strong understanding of modern outbound strategy, including segmentation, ICP development, account prioritization, enrichment, trigger-based outbound, personalization, and campaign measurement.

- Experience building or supporting web scraping and external data collection workflows using tools such as Apify, SerpAPI, browser automation, or similar technologies.

- Strong understanding of data quality, deduplication, matching, governance, monitoring, and maintaining production-grade data systems.

- Ability to think in systems and unit economics, balancing technical sophistication with cost, reliability, speed, and commercial value.

- Strong analytical and commercial judgment, with the ability to connect data architecture and technical decisions to pipeline creation and revenue outcomes.

- Ability to work closely with Marketing, Sales, Analytics, and technical teams and translate between GTM strategy and implementation.

- Experience in B2B SaaS, SMB go-to-market motions, healthcare, healthcare data, or provider data is preferred but not required.

postings.description:
Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@tebra.com, @patientpop.com, or @kareo.com) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.
About the Role

We are looking for a customer-focused individual to help shape the future of our Tebra platform. This role is an exciting and challenging opportunity to be a partner in an embedded team of cross-functional counterparts. You will be joining a close-knit, collaborative product design culture with a focus on raising the bar of the day-to-day product experience for our healthcare providers and their patients.

Your Area of Focus

- You contribute to the vision and design strategy that connects customer and business value.

- You have strong creative and conceptual design skills and the ability to evolve ideas that drive innovation.

- You have an effortless working knowledge of design fundamentals, principles, and core skills. 

- You build and utilize your product knowledge to navigate ambiguity, identify opportunities and define customer problem statements. 

- You need minimal direction on design methods and approaches to validate solutions. 

- You can facilitate cross-functional, collaborative ideation sessions using a variety of methods.

- You make proficient use of design system guidelines and contribute to components and patterns that include optimization and refinements to structural elements and patterns.

- You are a strong collaborator and communicator who creates understanding, drives alignment, and can work independently. 

- You are an effective presenter with the ability to anticipate questions and concerns, articulate a data supported point of view, synthesize and process feedback, and determine next steps.

- You have a working knowledge of business logic and dependencies between design, front-end development, and back-end technologies and the ability to successfully navigate the capabilities and constraints of existing technical systems.

- You work closely and in partnership with your product and engineering counterparts and outside of your core team inclusive of other designers, research, marketing, sales, and customer service.

- You can lead customer research sessions with some support and: interview customers effectively; guide the process to glean effective insights; and uncover and socialize areas of opportunity. 

- You possess a working understanding of various research methods, including rapid prototyping, card sorting, affinity mapping. 

- You are comfortable evaluating and leveraging AI tools to augment processes that result in efficiency and quality improvement.

- You seek out and incorporate both quantitative and qualitative data for use in reasoning and decision making.

- You seek out feedback and inputs from a variety of sources in order to move solutions forward, drive innovation, contribute to a connected and holistic overall experience for our customers and users, and invest in your relationships with peers and stakeholders.

Your Professional Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in a Product Design role (or comparable equivalent experience).

- Experience in B2B and/or B2C (SMB customer experience a plus; previous Healthcare a plus).

- Has a portfolio that demonstrates the following:

- Ability to deliver simplified, intuitive, and responsive user experiences for complex operations and flows (desktop web, mobile web, native app).

- Ability to use data insights to iterate on design solutions.

- Accomplished to expert level in several of the following skills:

- UX Design

- Visual User Interface Design

- Interaction Design

- Responsive Design

- Mobile + native mobile design

- Rapid Prototyping + iterative design

- Information Architecture

- Accessibility

- Qualitative + Quantitative data synthesis

- Experience working with a design system.

- Expert with Figma and FigJam.

- Proficiency in a variety of modern AI tools (such as Figma Make, Claude, Gemini, or Codex).

- Growth Mindset.

About the Role

You will support our finance organization and be a driver of revenue growth. Working closely with sales and account management leadership, you will ensure quotas are met, we have efficient and scalable commissions processes in place, and define a path for short-term and long-term growth.

Your Area of Focus

- Build and maintain accurate, repeatable reporting and dashboards that provide visibility into revenue performance, quotas, commissions, and key operational metrics; perform ad-hoc and deep-dive analysis to identify trends, risks, and root causes.

- Support recurring sales compensation processes, including payout validation, commission reporting and reconciliation, quota management, attainment reporting, forecasting, and special incentive administration.

- Investigate compensation, quota, reporting, and data discrepancies end-to-end, identify the underlying cause and broader impact, and partner with the appropriate teams to drive resolution.

- Partner with Sales, Account Management, Finance, Business Systems, Enablement, and other stakeholders to define requirements, improve processes, and implement scalable operational solutions.

- Provide clear, actionable, best-practice recommendations to business leaders that identify opportunities to increase bookings, while demonstrating how proposed solutions empower Sales and Customer Success teams to drive revenue growth and achieve business objectives.

- Own and execute recurring Revenue Operations processes with strong accuracy, prioritization, documentation, and communication, while progressively requiring less day-to-day direction as expertise grows.

- Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation tools to streamline recurring workflows, improve data quality, reduce manual effort, and increase operational efficiency as the Revenue Operations function scales.

- Required: 2-4 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, Finance, Business Analytics, or a related analytical role, with strong attention to detail.

- Required: Experience in optimizing workflows leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI)

- Required: Proficient in Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets, including working with large datasets, formulas, lookups, and data validation.

- Nice to have: Experience using SQL to query and analyze data; experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse is strongly preferred.

- Experience building reports and dashboards in Tableau or another business intelligence tool.

- Experience working with Salesforce or another CRM and the ability to quickly learn new systems and business processes.

- Structured problem solver with strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills who can identify root causes and communicate clear, actionable findings.

- Strong organization and prioritization skills with the ability to manage recurring deadlines and ad-hoc requests while maintaining accuracy.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work cross-functionally with stakeholders at different levels of the organization.

- Self-driven, curious, adaptable, and comfortable working in a dynamic, results-driven environment with increasing ownership and accountability.

- Comfortable using AI-powered tools to support analysis, documentation, process improvement, automation, and productivity.

postings.description:

About the Role

Tebra helps private practices bring modernized care to patients everywhere. To run our own business well, every team needs numbers it can trust.

We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help build Tebra's new internal analytics platform. You'll turn data from Salesforce, NetSuite, Stripe, our product, and other systems into one shared, tested set of business data and metrics that Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments all use. You'll lead projects end to end, set the standards others build on, and partner with business leaders to define the metrics that matter most.

Your Area of Focus

- Data Modeling & Shared Datasets: Design, build, and maintain enterprise-wide business data that teams across Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments build on. Apply dimensional modeling and layered design (staging, intermediate, and marts) so business logic lives in one place and isn't rebuilt by each team.

- Metric Definition & Semantic Layer: Partner with metric owners in Finance and the business to define each key metric once, with a named owner and documented logic. Publish governed metrics in a semantic layer that Tableau, AI assistants, and other tools query, and reconcile them to current reporting and the general ledger before teams switch over.

- Self-Service Enablement: Build easy-to-use datasets that let non-technical teammates and analysts answer their own questions without writing complex joins.

- Platform Migration: Lead projects end to end on the new internal analytics platform, from source data to dashboards. Move each team's reporting over one domain at a time, with clear cutover and rollback plans, and onboard the analysts who contribute to new conventions, review processes, and tools.

- Data Quality & Testing: Build automated tests and pull-request checks so data issues are caught before they reach reports. Monitor scheduled jobs, fix failures, and recover runs as part of shared production support.

- Performance & Efficiency: Tune SQL, models, and pipeline schedules so data refreshes on time and dashboards load in seconds. Monitor compute usage and cost, and choose how each model is built and refreshed to keep both in check.

- Forecasting & Machine Learning: Partner with analysts and data scientists to prepare clean, documented datasets for forecasting and machine learning models, such as retention and revenue projections.

- Code Review & Mentorship: Review code from analysts and engineers across teams, and coach them on modeling, SQL, and testing standards.

- Governance & Documentation: Follow data-sharing and privacy rules that keep protected health information (PHI) and personal data out of internal analytics. Maintain model documentation, lineage, and metric definitions via dbt, GitHub, Confluence, and Jira.

Your Professional Qualifications

- Experience: 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role, with 2+ years hands-on in dbt in production.

- SQL Fluency: Expert SQL, including window functions, CTEs, and performance tuning for queries and pipelines on large datasets.

- Data Modeling: Deep proficiency in dimensional modeling (Kimball), including shared datasets that serve many teams.

- Tech Stack: Proven experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, and with dbt.

- Business Partnership: Experience defining business metrics with Finance or business stakeholders, and reconciling data to financial systems.

- Software Mindset: Experience with GitHub for version control and code review, automated builds (GitHub Actions or similar), and Jira and Confluence for work tracking and documentation.

- Communication: Strong communication with people who aren't data specialists, and ability to execute under minimal supervision.

- Growth Mindset: Motivated to learn new technologies and develop new skills.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, economics, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- Semantic Layer: Experience with a semantic layer, such as Snowflake semantic views or the dbt Semantic Layer, preferred.

- Domain Knowledge: Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or Stripe data, and with subscription revenue, retention, or payments metrics, preferred.

- Forecasting & ML: Experience preparing data for forecasting or machine learning models preferred.

- Healthcare: Healthcare or HIPAA experience preferred.

- Additional Tools: Familiarity with Tableau, Terraform, or Okta a plus.

- Certifications: dbt Analytics Engineering or SnowPro certifications preferred.

You will bring practical AI fluency to both the products you build and the way you work. About the Role

The Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) team is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to lead the design, development, and adoption of AI-native capabilities across our billing and revenue cycle platform.

This role combines deep software engineering expertise with hands-on experience building production AI systems. You will help transform how healthcare organizations manage billing, payments, claims, and operational workflows by applying Large Language Models (LLMs), intelligent automation, retrieval systems, and agentic AI architectures to solve real-world business problems.

As a senior individual contributor, you will operate at the intersection of platform architecture, AI systems engineering, and business transformation. You will influence technical strategy across teams, design reusable AI capabilities, and establish engineering standards for building reliable, secure, and scalable AI-powered systems.

Your impact will come through technical leadership, architectural ownership, hands-on implementation, and your ability to translate complex business challenges into intelligent software solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.

Your Area of Focus

- Identify and implement practical opportunities to embed AI into backend services and business workflows where it can improve efficiency, accuracy, or decision support.

- Design and build production-ready AI-enabled services that combine application logic, APIs, and AI models to support real customer and operational use cases.

- Integrate LLMs, ML models, and external AI services into existing systems using strong engineering patterns for reliability, observability, and maintainability.

- Build workflows that use AI in a bounded, auditable way, with clear fallback behavior, evaluation, and human review where appropriate.

- Partner with product, design, data, and operational teams to turn workflow pain points into scalable software solutions with measurable impact.

- Lead Software Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable and maintainable software applications using Spring Boot, Java, React, and cloud technologies.

- Architect and Design: Collaborate with product managers, designers, and cross-functional teams to architect robust and scalable solutions that meet business requirements. Provide input into the technical direction of the team and product.

- Cloud Technology Expertise: Leverage experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.) to design cloud-native applications. Ensure that applications are optimized for scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency in a cloud environment.

- Code Reviews & Mentorship: Conduct thorough code reviews, ensuring that the team adheres to best practices for clean, maintainable, and efficient code. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

- Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with product and design teams to define requirements, deliver timely solutions, and provide technical expertise throughout the product lifecycle.

- Performance and Optimization: Monitor and optimize the performance of applications. Identify bottlenecks and implement performance improvements across both frontend (React) and backend (Java/Spring Boot) layers.

- Agile Development: Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, daily standups, retrospectives, and backlog grooming. Contribute to defining and prioritizing work within the team.

- Stay Current: Continuously research and apply emerging technologies and industry best practices to improve the development process and product quality.

Your Professional Qualifications

- Experience & Seniority: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building scalable distributed systems, with a track record of driving technical direction and architecture decisions without formal authority.

- Core Technical Stack: Absolute mastery of Java, Spring Boot, and Python for developing secure, high-throughput, cloud-native backend systems (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

- Production AI Experience: 2–3+ years of hands-on experience designing, shipping, and maintaining production AI-enabled or AI-native applications (combining LLMs, core application logic, and business workflows).

- AI Orchestration & Architecture: Practical experience with orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI) and a deep understanding of RAG, tool calling, prompt engineering, context/state management, and human-in-the-loop patterns.

- Systems Infrastructure & Data: Strong background in distributed systems, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and messaging platforms (e.g., Kafka).

- Production Safeguards & MLOps: Proven experience implementing enterprise AI guardrails, including real-time observability, latency/cost monitoring, automated evaluation pipelines, and robust fallback mechanisms.

- Collaboration: Impact-driven mindset with excellent cross-functional communication skills to bridge Engineering, Product, Design, and Operations.

- Advanced Agentic AI: Experience building autonomous, multi-step agentic systems utilizing multi-tier memory networks and recursive reasoning preferred.

- Domain Expertise: Prior background in Healthcare IT, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), billing, claims processing, fintech, or similarly regulated, high-compliance transaction environments preferred.

- Deep Data Retrieval: Hands-on experience with vector databases, semantic search architectures, and enterprise knowledge graph construction preferred.

- Advanced ML Tooling: Exposure to PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, custom embedding models, fine-tuning methodologies, or model serving optimization.

- Leadership Pedigree: Past experience serving as a Founding Engineer, Principal Architect, or early-stage platform lead driving organization-wide AI/ML adoption frameworks preferred.

postings.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Engineering
postings.description:
Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@tebra.com, @patientpop.com, or @kareo.com) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.
About the Role

The Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) team is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to lead the design, development, and adoption of AI-native capabilities across our billing and revenue cycle platform.

This role combines deep software engineering expertise with hands-on experience building production AI systems. You will help transform how healthcare organizations manage billing, payments, claims, and operational workflows by applying Large Language Models (LLMs), intelligent automation, retrieval systems, and agentic AI architectures to solve real-world business problems.

As a senior individual contributor, you will operate at the intersection of platform architecture, AI systems engineering, and business transformation. You will influence technical strategy across teams, design reusable AI capabilities, and establish engineering standards for building reliable, secure, and scalable AI-powered systems.

Your impact will come through technical leadership, architectural ownership, hands-on implementation, and your ability to translate complex business challenges into intelligent software solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.

Your Area of Focus

- Identify and implement practical opportunities to embed AI into backend services and business workflows where it can improve efficiency, accuracy, or decision support.

- Design and build production-ready AI-enabled services that combine application logic, APIs, and AI models to support real customer and operational use cases.

- Integrate LLMs, ML models, and external AI services into existing systems using strong engineering patterns for reliability, observability, and maintainability.

- Build workflows that use AI in a bounded, auditable way, with clear fallback behavior, evaluation, and human review where appropriate.

- Partner with product, design, data, and operational teams to turn workflow pain points into scalable software solutions with measurable impact.

- Lead Software Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable and maintainable software applications using Spring Boot, Java, React, and cloud technologies.

- Architect and Design: Collaborate with product managers, designers, and cross-functional teams to architect robust and scalable solutions that meet business requirements. Provide input into the technical direction of the team and product.

- Cloud Technology Expertise: Leverage experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.) to design cloud-native applications. Ensure that applications are optimized for scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency in a cloud environment.

- Code Reviews & Mentorship: Conduct thorough code reviews, ensuring that the team adheres to best practices for clean, maintainable, and efficient code. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

- Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with product and design teams to define requirements, deliver timely solutions, and provide technical expertise throughout the product lifecycle.

- Performance and Optimization: Monitor and optimize the performance of applications. Identify bottlenecks and implement performance improvements across both frontend (React) and backend (Java/Spring Boot) layers.

- Agile Development: Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, daily standups, retrospectives, and backlog grooming. Contribute to defining and prioritizing work within the team.

- Stay Current: Continuously research and apply emerging technologies and industry best practices to improve the development process and product quality.

Your Professional Qualifications

- Experience & Seniority: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building scalable distributed systems, with a track record of driving technical direction and architecture decisions without formal authority.

- Core Technical Stack: Absolute mastery of Java, Spring Boot, and Python for developing secure, high-throughput, cloud-native backend systems (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

- Production AI Experience: 2–3+ years of hands-on experience designing, shipping, and maintaining production AI-enabled or AI-native applications (combining LLMs, core application logic, and business workflows).

- AI Orchestration & Architecture: Practical experience with orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI) and a deep understanding of RAG, tool calling, prompt engineering, context/state management, and human-in-the-loop patterns.

- Systems Infrastructure & Data: Strong background in distributed systems, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and messaging platforms (e.g., Kafka).

- Production Safeguards & MLOps: Proven experience implementing enterprise AI guardrails, including real-time observability, latency/cost monitoring, automated evaluation pipelines, and robust fallback mechanisms.

- Collaboration: Impact-driven mindset with excellent cross-functional communication skills to bridge Engineering, Product, Design, and Operations.

- Advanced Agentic AI: Experience building autonomous, multi-step agentic systems utilizing multi-tier memory networks and recursive reasoning preferred.

- Domain Expertise: Prior background in Healthcare IT, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), billing, claims processing, fintech, or similarly regulated, high-compliance transaction environments preferred.

- Deep Data Retrieval: Hands-on experience with vector databases, semantic search architectures, and enterprise knowledge graph construction preferred.

- Advanced ML Tooling: Exposure to PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, custom embedding models, fine-tuning methodologies, or model serving optimization.

- Leadership Pedigree: Past experience serving as a Founding Engineer, Principal Architect, or early-stage platform lead driving organization-wide AI/ML adoption frameworks preferred.
